verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, so a unified place to manage local models, prompts, and per-model settings is a fair question for a buyer comparing LLM runtimes. The evidence covers only Hugging Face model loading, quantization backend overrides, the API server CLI, and benchmarking. Nothing shows a central interface for managing downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model configuration profiles.
